name: sloth-snapshot-consistent-slo-read-sessions
instr:
Sloth cannot keep SLO pagination, details, and ranges tied to one catalog revision while providers refresh. Add snapshot-consistent reads and opaque continuations across the application, UI, and MCP without exposing provider revision structure. Omitting snapshots must preserve current behavior.

Every fake, Prometheus, search, and measured SLOGetter must provide stable, nonempty revision sessions. Catalog, search, detail, and range reads stay isolated until idempotent closure releases the revision. Closed operations return ErrSLOReadSessionClosed from github.com/slok/sloth/internal/http/backend/storage with exact text "SLO read session closed".

Snapshot pagination returns every match exactly once, preserving direction and query identity without falling forward to current data. Malformed or query-incompatible continuations return ErrSLOSnapshotInvalid with exact text "invalid SLO snapshot". Unavailable revisions return ErrSLOSnapshotExpired with exact text "SLO snapshot expired", without partial results. Empty results and unknown SLOs remain distinct successful or not-found outcomes.

UI and MCP must round-trip the same opaque traversal identity. UI query changes restart traversal; explicit incompatible MCP reuse is rejected. Identical UI and MCP queries produce the same revision-bound records and navigation direction. A grouped listing keeps its grouping, metadata, and shortest-window choice for detail, SLI availability, and burned-budget ranges.
